property.name: suiteName

Should delete the flag HANDOVER SYNC INFO AFTER ISSUE flag in SystemConfiguration through API if it exists
Should set system config of COST ASSIGNMENT CONTRACT ITEM back to default with split mandatory false with API
Should create the BILLING IMPLEMENTATION of NEW system config if it does not exist update it if it does

Should create the working hours billing conditions tied to the counter we added earlier if it doesnt already exist
Should create the working hours pricing procedure steps if they dont already exist

testcase.name: Should set system config of COST ASSIGNMENT REQUEST ITEM to the used request items payload
